user_prompt: What is the effect of a fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy combination, compared with gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel, on overall survival in adults with advanced pancreatic cancer?  This is specifically the comparison: fluoropyrimidine-based combination regimens (e.g. regimens combining nab-paclitaxel or gemcitabine with a fluoropyrimidine such as S-1, capecitabine, or 5-FU/leucovorin) versus gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel as the comparator. Do NOT include trials comparing different DOSES or dosing schedules of gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel against each other — that is a separate comparison in this review. Do NOT include any other comparator (e.g. best supportive care, gemcitabine alone, or fluoropyrimidine alone) — those are also separate comparisons in this review, each with their own "overall survival" outcome.  The single target outcome is OVERALL SURVIVAL — not progression-free survival, response rate, or any grade 3/4 adverse event outcome.  Please extract the Risk Ratio (RR) directly from each paper's own Cox proportional hazards / time-to-event survival analysis (log[HR] and its SE, or RR with its 95% CI) — do not approximate a hazard ratio from response-rate or adverse-event counts; if a paper does not report a Cox-model RR for overall survival, treat it as not usable for this outcome rather than substituting a different statistic.
